stories.title: “We’re just so grateful to have him”: Rupert’s first birthday set to light up Flintshire
stories.summary: Buildings and landmarks across Flintshire will be lit up tonight for Rupert, a one-year-old boy who lives with an ultra-rare neurological condition, as his family marks his first birthday. stories.title: Wales Netball hails Deeside as first Welsh team in Premier League
stories.summary: Deeside Netball have won promotion to the England Netball Premier League, with the club and Wales Netball saying they are the first Welsh team to reach the competition. stories.title: Police stinger stops A55 driver in late-night arrest
stories.summary: A man has been arrested on the A55 near St Asaph after North Wales Police stopped a car they suspected was being driven by someone without a licence. stories.title: More than 1,300 children to join Kids of Steel triathlon in Mold
stories.summary: More than 1,300 children from more than 30 Flintshire schools will take part in a mini-triathlon at Mold Leisure Centre on Tuesday 16 June.
